name: Между нами химия
summary: Tanya brings up two children alone during the day, and works in a taxi at night. Everything changes when she finds out about a serious diagnosis. Now she is worried about only one thing: who will the children stay with if the disease turns out to be stronger? Tanya is not ready to entrust them to unreliable relatives and decides to find a decent man, marry him to herself, so that if anything happens, he will take care of the children. The only person Tanya shares her thoughts with is her doctor. Suddenly, the plan works, and at some point there are too many applicants.

name: Wildes Italien
summary: Italy is not without reason one of the world's most popular holiday destinations.  Yet its fascinating wildlife remains largely unknown: wolves and brown bears in the forests of Northern Italy, flamingos in the Po delta and dolphins off the coast of Sicily.  Stunning time-lapse and slow-motion footage show the country's flora and fauna in a completely new light and landscapes unfold impressively in majestic aerial photography.  This two-part documentary sets itself apart from others of its kind, with spectacular pictures capturing the unique light and atmosphere of Italy.

name: Hope in the Water
summary: Stories of aqua farmers and fishermen striving for a sustainable future for the globe. Innovative solutions and ground-breaking blue food technology to save fresh waterways in addition to providing food for human consumption.

name: Proof
summary: Proof pairs two unlikely heroes together – disgruntled FBI Agent-in-Training Ginger Rodriguez and John "Proof" Prufrock, a jazz-loving Bigfoot – to protect the world from Cryptids: obscure creatures whose existence has yet to be proven. While these two start out as a surprising duo, they strike up an unlikely friendship, partnership, and even potential romance as they help save the world side by side.

name: Prosta sprawa
summary: The heroes fight in the seemingly idyllic setting of the Karkonosze Mountains, against which the international drug trade takes place. Who will support the nameless avenger and who will stand behind the demonic boss of the local mafia? It's only a seemingly simple matter.

name: Планета собак
summary:
A dog has been man's best friend for several thousand years. It is not known exactly where and when people domesticated the dog. Most likely, this happened in southern Africa, where the oldest breed of dog, the Africanis, still lives.
Probably no one knows the exact number of dog breeds in the world. More than 450 of them are officially registered. The host of the "Planet of Dogs" program, Grigory Manev, went on a trip around the world to different countries and continents to understand how and why chow-chows and chihuahuas, lapdogs and shepherd dogs, setters and spaniels, mastiffs and retrievers.
Amazing canine geography: from China, Malta and France to Spain, Holland, Russia and South Africa. Grigory meets dogs everywhere and every time he is convinced that dogs and owners are very similar to each other, no matter where they live.

name: КиноFail
summary:
It's no secret that people make mistakes. Every person involved in the production of a film can also make a mistake. The screenwriter will add a dubious fact to the plot; the cameraman will not notice the dangling microphone in the frame. Between shots, the actor suddenly changed his clothes - thanks to the editor and continuity. How many of these errors fit in one film? One or two? Oh if only!
Especially for you, the creators of KinoFail took a closer look at the smallest details in the frame, and prepared video reports on blunders in well-known films.

name: Убить змея
summary: The mystical series "Kill the Snake" is based on the book by Valery Vainin in the fantasy genre. The forces of Darkness represented by the Snake clan oppose the forces of Light represented by the Mongoose clan. The serpent must build a pyramid, at the head of which he will be able to control humanity. At the base of the pyramid, he gathers talented and influential people, politicians, bandits. Mongoose's task is to figure out the Snake and defeat him before he manages to complete the pyramid. This has happened many times in the history of mankind, and now the Serpent is building his pyramid in the 21st century in Moscow. The mongoose, under the guise of school French teacher Gleb, begins to look for him in order to fight. His friends help him in his search.

name: KRANK Berlin
summary: Managing a chaotic emergency room in the toughest and most overcrowded hospital in Berlin is no small task for the young Dr. Parker, who is seeking a fresh start in the big city after her private life implodes in Munich. When she tries to implement necessary reforms, Parker is confronted with resistance from the underpaid, ill-equipped and chronically fatigued hospital staff who only survive with an indispensable dose of black humor. But in the face of an increasingly merciless healthcare system, the battered team must put aside their differences and pull together to save lives.

name: Docent
summary: Associate Professor Stehlík transfers from the police academy to the homicide department due to a near-administrative error. He joins the team right after the detectives begin investigating the brutal murder of a young woman in a forest near Prague.

name: Kill Bitcoin!
summary: The definitive story of Dr Ruja Ignatova, the founder of a multi-billion-dollar cryptocurrency company called OneCoin who suddenly disappeared, leaving millions of people high and dry in her wake.

name: Princess Across Time
summary: Modern forensic science student Tang Bing'er unexpectedly finds herself in the body of Qin Xiyue, the notorious concubine of the Heng Kingdom. Using her forensic knowledge, she unravels mysteries, solves numerous strange cases, and joins forces with Crown Prince Ling Xuan. Together, they bring stability to the Heng Kingdom and protect its people

name: Fight for Love
summary: After her father's death in battle and a mysterious warning from her injured brother, Chu Yu vows to uncover the truth. She marries into the defeated Wei family as her late brother's widow to investigate, where she meets the sole survivor, Wei Yun. Though initially guarded, Wei Yun grows fond of Chu Yu, and mutual feelings emerge. Despite the obstacle of their "in-law" relationship, they face dangers together, uncover secrets, and protect their homeland side by side.

name: See Her Again
summary: The story uses a time-displaced character relationship to help solve a case spanning 25 years. It blends crime suspense with warmth. Through a series of cases triggered by a building fire in the 1990s, it tells the story of Hong Kong police pursuing justice and family bonds, while showcasing the changes in Hong Kong's urban culture and human relationships before and after its return to China.

name: See You Later... Maybe
summary: In Huanxi City, Fang Haowen's pen is the cheapest weapon there is. It cannot produce bestsellers, yet it can cut through the absurdity of reality. Recognized by businesswoman Jin Furong, he rises to fame overnight, only to crash back down after turning down her love. A drunken fall from a building and a staged "suicide" farce push him into the eye of the internet storm, as his former agent eggs him on to "trade death for sales" and regain viral fame. Then obsessive fan Bie Fan shows up and wrecks the whole carefully scripted livestream scam. That's how the "Jiong Tu" duo comes to be: a has-been writer and his delusional young fan launching into a wild, can't-live-can't-die escapade.

name: D.I.D. 12
summary: A detective, police superintendent, and psychologist team up to stop a secret assassin network targeting victims based on the New Seven Deadly Sins. As the case deepens, each of them is forced to confront buried secrets, leading to a race against time to stop the next execution.

name: Generation to Generation
summary: The story follows the decisive and cunning young master Mu Qingyan and the laid-back, free-spirited heroine Cai Zhao, whose intense relationship oscillates between sweetness and anguish. Together, they navigate the treacherous martial world, exposing the "masks" worn by its inhabitants. Their journey is filled with love, hate, constant twists, and strategic battles, painting a vivid picture of a heroic and dynamic martial arts community.

name: Vanished Name
summary: A casual name. A stolen name. A name that was never hers. A name she dared not speak again. A name never forgotten. Ren Xiaoming had always despised her name, yet no matter how much she loathed it, it was proof of her existence in this world—the very premise of her identity. She would reclaim the name that had been stolen from her. This name did not belong to her alone, but to many others as well. Those invisible names, lost in the mundane routines of daily life, drowned in the whispers of judgment, buried in the endless passage of time—stripped of their identities. Yet someone always remembers them, and someone always follows in their footsteps, until their names are seen by all. A story of struggle and redemption across two generations of women.

name: Hanging Mirrors
summary: A grisly dismemberment case unites two cops with clashing styles, Xu Xiao and Lin Guoqiang, forging a mentor-mentee bond. They uncover a sinister link between the case and an ancient evil ritual for immortality, orchestrated by a seemingly harmless, highly educated young woman.

name: Gloria's House
summary: Zany, crazy, awkward and misunderstood - it's the Nits family. Watch out, they're moving in next door!

name: Charlie Hustle & the Matter of Pete Rose
summary: Charlie Hustle & the Matter of Pete Rose chronicles the life and career of Pete Rose, baseball's all-time hits leader, who received a lifetime ban from the game after a Major League Baseball investigation revealed he bet on the Cincinnati Reds to win games during his time as manager of the team. Charlie Hustle & the Matter of Pete Rose provides intimate access to the polarizing former player as he embarks on a new bid for reinstatement in the MLB and a place in the National Baseball Hall of Fame.

name: Einstein
summary: In Einstein brilliant but directionless, the great grandson of Albert Einstein spends his days as a comfortably tenured professor until his bad boy antics land him in trouble with the law and he is pressed into service helping a local police detective solve her most puzzling cases.

name: Tor
summary: La sèrie documental sobre el crim de Tor: Carles Porta reviu la llegenda de la muntanya maleïda.

name: Vanina - Un vicequestore a Catania
summary: The deputy commissioner Vanina Guarrasi, after a brilliant career in the anti-mafia, left Palermo in an attempt to escape the past and the bond with the two men she loved most: her policeman father and her ex-boyfriend Paolo Malfitano, a magistrate operating in the anti-mafia. The crazy fear of reliving certain traumas has taken over: and so here is Vanina in Catania, in the new role in the Homicide Section, supported by the esteem of a new team of policemen. And by the affection of her friends.

name: Astro-Mano
summary: Pedro and Astro-Mano are separated by a galaxy. Pedro leads a monotonous and meaningless life and Astro-Mano lives on a planet where his value is not recognized. Pedro is fired from his job and Astro Mano, by accident, crashes to Earth. Their meeting gives rise to an unlikely friendship that will change both their lives. Astro-Mano wants to help Pedro find meaning in his life and Pedro wants to help him return home, but there is someone who will do everything to prevent this from happening. And only the two of them, together, can defeat him. A journey sharing two worlds where the adventures that await them will make them discover their own value. Life is a journey, join us.

name: Bunny Maloney
summary: Welcome to Bunnyville! Amidst the neon signs and the pulsing rhythms of Bunnyville,meet four unlikely friends: Bunny Maloney, Candy Bunny, Jean-François and Stan Ookie. At worst, they are a conflicted band of self-absorbed neurotics. At best, they are the self-appointed Superhero Crime Fighters of Protecteam who combat the threats of the evil scientist Professor Débilouman.

name: Märchenperlen
summary: Märchenperlen is ZDF's series of fairy tale adaptations, which has existed since 2005. These are often fairy tales by the Brothers Grimm, which are mainly broadcast in the Christmas program. The films are based on the classic traditions, but have been modernized in terms of narrative and content (e.g. Little Red Riding Hood). Outdated statements and symbolism from the original version were reinterpreted or supplemented in order to take contemporary linguistic sensitivity into account.

previousepisode.name: Rapunzel und die Rückkehr der Falken

name: Острог. Дело Федора Сеченова
summary: The head of the pre-trial detention center was killed. Fyodor Sechenov is assigned to investigate the crime. Trying to understand who could have killed his friend, the investigator is faced with negativity from employees and prisoners. At the same time, a valuable archive disappears from prison. Gradually, Fedor realizes that a real person is involved in the mysterious events, who has subjugated the entire detention center. Will he be able to find the puppet master before the next murder occurs?

previousepisode.name: Tomàs Fuentes, Ignasi Taltavull y las puertas automáticas

name: The Auditors
summary: At JU Construction Company, notorious for countless corruption cases, the audit team is busy at work. The team comprises a polar opposite duo: a cold team leader and a generous Gen Z employee. Together, they navigate through turbulent teamwork at first. Yet, as they collectively tackle diverse cases, they harmonize into an unstoppable investigative pair.

name: One South: Portrait of a Psych Unit
summary: An intimate look at this in-patient psych unit that treats young adults who struggle with mental health disorders.

name: Три сестры
summary: Three sisters, Ira, Olya and Masha, have long dreamed of leaving Nizhny Novgorod for Moscow. Each sister has her own moving scenario, but they all secretly rely on the financial help of her mother, the owner of Tatiana's jewelry business. However, Tatiana has other plans for life: as a souvenir from her vacation, she brings a massage therapist 20 years younger than herself. And while the whole town is gossiping about a sudden romance, the daughters suspect that the new family member is an ordinary conman. They intend to open Tatiana's eyes to the truth, but does a woman who just wants to be happy need her?

name: Дети перемен
summary: Keeping a Family Together When the Country Is Falling Apart. A Crime Saga at the Turn of the Epochs

name: East Harbour Heroes
summary: East Harbour Heroes is a saltwater-soaked journey to St. John's, N.L., where a vibrant community of tough individuals battle the rugged coast and the North Atlantic Ocean to live and work on the edge of the world. From brutal storms, high winds, and changing fish populations, each day brings a new challenge to commercial fishers, stevedores, crane operators, welders, and tugboat operators, and these warriors are determined to thrive – no matter what Mother Nature throws at them.

previousepisode.name: Long May Your Big Jib Draw

name: Family
summary: After 90 spicy teacher, independent woman Gu Xiaomeng attaches importance to career, the pursuit of self-worth, operating a beautiful "small indeed lucky" life, but was suddenly "both parents" disrupted, marriage and career into a deadlock. When the unreliable brother, the strong mother, the parent-in-law, the rebellious transfer student, Once missed the campus lovers, and accidentally pregnant baby to crush the avalanche of Gu Xiaomeng's life, the only ally husband Lv Xiang, but also because of unemployment, re-entrepreneurship, and even because of the verge of derailment, from "God assists" to "pig teammates." Gu Xiaomeng, a clever teacher who always wins against her students, encounters Waterloo in her marriage, so she rethinks the meaning of marriage and family, completes self-transformation and reconciliation with her mother, and finally grows into a real all-conquering but rigid-flexible Big Lady.

name: No One But You
summary:
After her sister's tragic death, Yu Qinghuan was adopted by her brother-in-law, Jiang Mohan, a powerful warlord, and was raised to become the owner of a pleasure house. To her shock, the man she admired and respected was the very one she wished to kill—the murderer of her sister. Jiang Mohan believed he could remain heartless, but he ultimately fell for her. As the fog clears, their twisted love and fated bond emerge amidst hatred. Will the misunderstandings and pain between them become barriers or ties that bind?

Play

name: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge
summary: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge puts a playful competition spin on the bears of Alaska's Katmai National Park as they bulk up for winter hibernation. Over 150 days, the bears battle the elements - and each other - using brains and brawn to consume three million calories and gain up to 200 pounds in Nature's real-life survival show. Unbeknownst to the bears, their progress is being tracked and ranked for a television audience with narration that combines fascinating facts about bear behavior with clever color commentary.

previousepisode.name: So Long and Thanks for All the Fish

name: Vietnam: The War That Changed America
summary: The Vietnam War is one of the most controversial wars in United States history, and as battles were beamed into the nation's living rooms night after night, widespread protests led to a fundamental shift in America's national identity. Hundreds of film crews captured the action as it unfolded on the battlefield and now, through meticulous journalism, Vietnam: The War That Changed America tracks down the soldiers and civilians on all sides who lived through the war, bringing them together, often for the first time in almost half a century. Each episode features powerful reunions and the emotional stories told by those who faced agonizing life or death situations and impossible moral decisions. Across six episodes a picture also builds of the profound changes to America itself, and a very different country that emerged out of the war.

name: The Pork Cutlets
summary: A tragic human comedy drama about the village head who took the lead in neutering Onghwa Village's Cassanova dog, Baek-goo, and ends up in the same situation as the dog when he suddenly undergo a vasectomy.

name: Good Partner
summary: Facing her own divorce, seasoned divorce lawyer Cha Eun Kyung has grown jaded with the concept of Justice, instead opting for the path with the most monetary gain. This changes after she begins working with passionate rookie lawyer Han Yoo Ri, who believes in helping people regardless of the money.

name: The Night Caller
summary:
Tony, in his 50s, drives a black cab, doing the night shift in the city. He used to be a popular and respected teacher but after losing his job, his confidence plummeted, his marriage collapsed, and he's become increasingly isolated. Now his only lifelines are cafe-worker Rosa, whom he forms a growing attachment to, and a radio DJ called Lawrence whom he spends his nights listening to.

One night Tony plucks up the courage and rings NightTalk to speak to Lawrence, and soon becomes a ‘friend of the show'. For the first time in years, he feels listened to. But as time passes, his developing bond with the late-night DJ begins to turn into an unhealthy obsession as he starts interpreting Lawrence's ‘world view' in dangerous ways that have devastating impacts on Tony's life.

One night, by chance, Lawrence gets into Tony's cab. The initial excitement at meeting takes a turn when Tony realises this DJ isn't the man he purports to be. Lawrence is a fake and Tony feels betrayed.

The Night Caller is a claustrophobic tale about the power of influence those with the loudest voice have over the most vulnerable people.

name: Paul Whitehouse's Sketch Show Years
summary:
Paul Whitehouse celebrates sketch shows in a new four-part series.

Personally curated and narrated by Paul, the series takes viewers on a journey through his favourite British sketch shows of the past 60 years, with each episode broadly covering a decade in sketch show history, from iconic shows such as The Two Ronnies, to The Catherine Tate Show which have mirrored the story of modern Britain.

name: The Battle for Number 10
summary: General Election results from a 360-degree immersive studio normally used by Sky Sports shows like Monday Night Football.

previousepisode.name: The Battle for Number 10: Politics Hub With Sophy Ridge

name: Человек войны
summary: WWII. A detachment of underground partisans under the leadership of commander Shmakov is hiding out in a forest near the front lines. They are joined by a reconnaissance group led by Major Semin from State Security. The day to day life of the partisans is extremely tense, as they risk their lives fighting the enemy and encounter conflicts within their own group. Hoping to enhance his career, Semin contacts Shimmel, a highly place German spy, in an attempt to recruit him for the Soviet side. During the encounter, Semin is given false information about chemical bombs supposedly developed by the Germans. Semin immediately informs central command, sure that he will be rewarded for his important discovery. However, central command decides that the tip needs to be confirmed and sends reconnaissance officer Lida Eisenschmidt to get close to Shimmel and get to the bottom of the chemical weapons story. Kurt Shimmel and Lida Eisenschmidt are well matched adversaries. They are both professionals and brave opportunists, able to control themselves in the most extreme conditions. Both are lonely, surrounded by colleagues who cannot appreciate their skill or understand their dance with death. Kurt and Lida are predators - born of war - who have lost all traces of their humanity. But perhaps that is the essence of human nature.

name: Нежное чудовище
summary:
Based on the story "Actress" by Ekaterina Markova.
In a famous Moscow drama theater, mysterious murders occur one after another. The main director of the troupe, Alena Pozdnyakova, becomes the only person who can determine the motives, explain the goals and reveal the relationship of these crimes.
The entire theatrical environment of Alena is involved in the whirlpool of events, and she herself barely escapes cruel reprisals. Now the girl is forced to be the main participant in this tragic "theatrical detective story"...

name: Дети Ванюхина
summary: Adult life for simple village guy Sasha Vanyukin starts with murder. However, the draw of a beautiful life in the big city turned out to be stronger than any crisis of conscience and the murder case remained unclosed. Vanyukin's business started with petty theft and unlawful trading of rare icons and, in the upheaval of the early 90's, this is what brought him success and made him the owner of a major bank. But, in life you pay for your mistakes, and Vanyukin has a long list of sins. He doesn't suspect that the long forgotten murder will become a curse for him, his family and his children...

name: Плата за любовь
summary: Mikhail left to serve in the army, and Lida remained waiting for him in his hometown. After the first skirmish with the "grandfathers" - a trial and a sentence for manslaughter. Having been released, Mikhail returns home, where everything has become different - life in the city is determined by the local oligarch, who is served by both Mikhail's half-brother and Lida, who performs "special functions." Mikhail finds his place in this life, but soon he has a conflict with the son of the oligarch - an influential and presumptuous businessman who decides to eliminate Mikhail. Only those who love can save him. At the same time, they are ready to pay the highest price for their love...

name: Аэропорт
summary: Airport resembles a small country, but native part of it is smaller then the foreigners part. It's hard to tell the genre of series as one can find elements of comedy, drama and melodrama in it. The main part of the Airoport is people. Employees of different services with their problems, concerns and happiness.

name: The Korean War
summary: On par with previous shows featuring The Great War and World War II in real-time, week by week, the third documentary focuses on Korean war. It is covered week by week, following the war in real-time.

name: Lola, érase una vez
summary:
This is the romantic and fun story of Lola, a modern Cinderella, rebellious and optimistic, who does not sit back and wait for a fairy godmother to solve her problems with her wand, but goes out into the world to find happiness on her own.

Lola, érase una vez, is a beautiful story for young people and their families, a modern fairy tale, but full of music, joy, emotion, optimism and, above all, love.

name: Hasta el Fin del Mundo Te Amare
summary: Sofia lives a life of success. She falls in love with her personal driver Salvador and they struggle to keep their relationship together.

name: Raue Welten - Wilde Schönheiten - Die Balkanhalbinsel
Snatchback
summary: Inspired by the life of a real covert intelligence officer who is still active in the field today, the series follows a highly skilled privately contracted team of operatives as they recover hostages across the globe from some of the most exotic and equally dangerous locations on the planet.

name: Van Helsing
summary: Van Helsing is a contemporary take on the monster hunter Dr. Abraham Van Helsing, who uses his uniquely inquisitive mind working alongside his ex, relentless FBI special agent Mina Harker, to solve New York City's most harrowing cases.

name: Yao Wo Cheng Feng Du Shan Hai
The West Coast Hustle
summary: The West Coast Hustle chronicles Chanel's life, capturing all its exciting and memorable moments. Fans get an intimate look at her journey as she navigates the challenges of her new favorite full-time gig - motherhood - while simultaneously pursuing her music career. Juggling a personal life with her boyfriend Dom, a high-pressure career and maintaining friendships — Chanel is determined to hustle and have it all!

name: Hot Ones Versus
summary: "Hot Ones" spin-off series where guests have two choices: Tell the truth, or suffer the wrath of the Last Dab. Whoever eats the most wings, loses.

name: Greatest Ever Wind Ups
summary: A look back at classic hidden camera pranks along with the people originally involved.

name: Ghosts
summary: Ghosts centres around young couple Emma and Felix, who inherit an old mansion and decide to turn it into a hotel. After a near-death accident Emma suddenly starts to see ghosts. These bizarre and chaotic roommates, including characters such as the Neanderthal Urs, the Roman legionnaire Claudius, the Countess Adelheid, the feminist maid Griet, the insurance salesman Joachim, the teacher Svenni and the love-hungry poet Friedrich Dorn come from different eras and cause quite a stir in the couple's lives.

name: Coldwater
summary:
When his failure to intervene in a violent confrontation in a playground brings his identity crisis to a head, John ups and moves his family to the rural idyll of Coldwater, as far away from London as possible.

Upon arrival, John is quickly befriended by next-door neighbour Tommy, a charming, confident man, devoted husband to the local vicar Rebecca. He is a man of faith, a pillar of the community and self-appointed leader of the village's all-male book group.  

John is both impressed and slightly fascinated by Tommy. His wife Fiona despises him. As a successful former chef hoping to launch a new venture in Coldwater, Fiona sees the move as an opportunity to leave the past behind them. To not only re-build their lives as a family but re-ignite the long-lost spark in their fading marriage. When her husband's relationship with their enigmatic new neighbour becomes increasingly intense, Fiona's suspicions are aroused. She is unconvinced Tommy is all he seems to be.

But John remains blissfully unaware that Tommy is harbouring horrifying secrets, and it's only after a series of unsettling incidents start to occur that John begins to wonder who the real Tommy actually is.

name: Secrets of the Supermarket Buyers
summary: Secrets of the Supermarket Buyers will see Denise meet with current and former buyers from Britain's biggest supermarket chains to find out just how they decide what to sell to the nation's consumers. From the discount disruptors to the premium grocers, the series will lift the lid on the tactics used by behind-the-scenes buyers to get popular items into stores and, ultimately, into shoppers' trolleys. How do they predict demand and what the next big trends will be?

name: The Rosenberg Report
summary: Joel C. Rosenberg is a respected geo-political expert on the Middle East. Each week, he offers a close-up view of current events and issues in this volatile region, bringing important insights and biblical perspective.

name: Будем знакомы!
summary: A film about the life of a group of first-year students, future television journalists. Each of the young heroes of the film tries in their own way to gain authority among friends and teachers, to establish themselves in the student body and profession.

name: Graverne
summary: How much will you sacrifice for the truth? And must the truth emerge at all costs? New journalistic crime series with Mille Dinesen in the lead role focuses on investigative journalism and what the investigative journalists have to go through as democracy's watchdogs.

name: Lucrecia: un crimen de odio
summary: Lucrecia's murder begins a journey to the roots of hatred in this gripping tale with unseen footage.

name: Мокрые майки
summary: By the age of 30, ex-stripper Mara acutely feels a crisis of self-realization. To prove to everyone around her that she can do more than just strip for money, the girl decides to go into business and persuades her former sponsor Yurich to let her manage a beauty salon. Mara becomes the manager, not of a beauty salon, but of a dilapidated car wash on the outskirts of the city. Will a former stripper be able to master a new social role and make a not-so-successful business profitable?

name: Publio: El secuestro sin fin
summary: A four-part docuseries chronicling one of the longest cold cases in Spanish history: the 1995 kidnapping of businessman Publio Cordon.

name: Дино
summary: In the 90s, Dino worked for tough gangster Montana and was Moscow's most ruthless debt collector. Now he lives as a hermit in the province. But events unfold in such a way that Dino returns to the capital and starts his old job in order to pay off his debt from the past, which has tormented him all these years and return the woman of his dreams. During Dino's adventures, he will have to face both modern realities and the relict 90s, which have adapted somewhere, withered somewhere, but still deeply rooted in our reality. And Dino, as a guide between two worlds, will once again have to undergo a test of his life principles.

name: жЫЫЫзнь
summary: The primitive era of human history can hardly be called a paradise like the biblical Eden. Instead of a quiet life, two tribes living along the banks of one wide river face severe danger every day. The Chief's tribe is losing ground due to the weakness and inexperience of their leader, who wants to be a friend to everyone. But the tribe of "morons" led by the Leader is at the peak of its strength and lives in prosperity. Therefore, one of the Leader's hunters runs away to his competitors, and the Leader's people joyfully accept him. But few of the savages understand what is really happening on the other side.

name: Traqués
summary: Franck and his longtime friends enjoy spending their weekends hunting together, but one Sunday, they come across another group of hunters who start targeting them without explanation. When one of their party is shot, Franck's friends strike back, sending an attacker to the ground. Barely managing to escape, the four friends keep the event a secret. Franck tries to go back to his life as usual alongside his wife Krystel, but in the next few days, he starts to feel like he and his friends are being watched, or worse, tracked by hunters who are now hell-bent on revenge.

name: Gossip Princess
summary: To find her way home, Liang Hong must collect all five glass beads, but she accidentally "messes with" five men. Liang Hong has been repeatedly "forced to marry", which not only causes her to get into scandals but also makes her a player from a person who's never been in a relationship before. Then she becomes a female version of "Wei Xiaobao", who's got seven wives, in Jiankang City. She was going to run away after the scam, but she's caught up in a conspiracy...

name: Serenata De Las Estrellas
summary: Get ready for a heartwarming and surprise-filled musical journey with Serenata de las Estrellas. Hosted by Julissa Bermudez, some of the biggest names in Latin music surprise deserving members of the community with once-in-a-lifetime concerts in unexpected locations. From church fundraisers to taquerias, no place is off-limits for these pop-up performances, with real people, real stars, and real surprises.

previousepisode.name: Los Lobos Honors Church Janitor With A Surprise Serenade

name: The Au Pair
summary:
The Au Pair follows a woman who seems to have it all—a successful husband, adorable stepchildren, a thriving business and a gorgeous home. When her diabetic father moves in next door and she begins to experience marital issues, however, she reluctantly agrees to hire an au pair. A beguiling young French woman takes the job and causes an unsettling shift in the household.

As instincts and suspicions arise, hidden agendas are hinted at and long-concealed truths are unveiled.

name: Prison Chronicles
summary: Prison Chronicles takes you inside some of the world's most notorious prisons. Every episode delves into the unique history of a specific prison, showcasing its wildest practices, infamous inmates, harrowing events, and ingenious escapes. Spanning 1,000 years, the series covers legendary institutions from the historic Tower of London to today's high-tech ADX, where El Chapo is currently held. Through interviews with journalists, former correctional officers, and previously incarcerated individuals, the series offers an authentic glimpse into the inner workings of these prisons.

name: Paradis de rouille
summary: Plunge into a journey across atypical cemeteries and discover the colossal beauty of cars' graveyards, supertankers, trains, military vehicles and abandoned ruins around the world. Some of these testimonies of our industrial civilization are classified in the World Heritage, others are under threat of reversal or erasure. This series takes us to meet collectors, biologists, and environmentalists who defend the new ecosystems that have taken over these wrecks. A breathtaking and patrimonial voyage to a spectacular and totally unrevealed world.

previousepisode.name: [ZBTVing] 역대급 서스펜스 반전 플레이 | 임포스터를 찾아라

name: Chastity High
summary: When an ultra-elite high school enforces a strict "No Romance" rule that expels anyone caught dating, a student secretly helps her classmates for cash.

name: Flashback
summary: Elsa, a forensic agent, is propelled in 1994, a few months before her father's murder and takes the opportunity to become her teammate to prevent her death, without ever revealing her true identity.

name: Teenage Textbook: The Series
summary: 17-year-old Mui Ee has only one goal – become an engineer and get a secure job. Just follow the SOP and everything will be ok…right? Of course not! We're talking teenagers here - first year poly students navigating the perils of teen romance, social media minefields, annoying cliques, late assignments and over-zealous parents. There are no SOPs! A reluctant Mui Ee is soon pulled into the web of teen drama involving herself, her friends and the hottest boy in poly. To make things worse, Mui Ee has to babysit her dad as he tries to turn the book, "The Teenage Textbook " into a modern-day app for teens. With all the drama swirling around, Mui Ee has to eventually confront her greatest fear – if she deviates from the set path, will she make an irreversible decision she'll regret for the rest of her life? Mui Ee thinks she knows the answer to that, and part of the fun is finding out if she's right!

name: Glastonbury Highlights
summary: Get your Glasto fix with a selection of performances from the festival in 2024.

name: Play Like a Sponge
summary:
Nickelodeon UK & Ireland is inviting viewers to Play Like a Sponge this summer in a brand-new short-form series in which SpongeBob has assembled a team of kids to try a selection of Paralympic sports and meet real life Paralympic legends.

Produced in partnership with ParalympicsGB, Play Like a Sponge will inspire kids to find their inner SpongeBob SquarePants as the Nickelodeon icon cheers them on in their quest to learn about and sample new sports with paralympic athletes ahead of the upcoming Paralympic games in Paris this August.

name: Carpe Diem
summary: At 48, Tom Villeneuve is finally free. Wrongly accused of murdering his wife, Tom has just spent 17 years in prison. Combative, he studies law in prison and when he is released, he becomes a lawyer. Back in his hometown, Nice, he is determined to find out who the real murderer is. He opens his own practice as a "young" lawyer and defends those he believes to be unjustly accused of crime, like him.

name: Commandant Saint-Barth
summary: Officer Gabriel Saint-Barthélémy isn't your average detective. Growing up in a resort on a Caribbean island, he knows both the bright and the dark side of paradise. Saint Barts is a chameleon-like inspector, very good at putting himself in his victims' shoes. And when it comes to solving cases on this paradisiacal Caribbean Island frequented by VIPs, being a Very Intrusive Policeman proves to be particularly effective.

name: Menace Imminente
summary: A legend of Israeli intelligence, Zeev Abadi, is urgently recalled to track down the traitor who stole highly dangerous software developed in utmost secrecy by Unit 8200, a branch of the Israeli Army, and used in Paris for the first time. This mission leads him to collaborate with a French counter-terrorism officer, Fleur Giroud, tasked with solving a strange disappearance that occurred in broad daylight at Charles de Gaulle Airport... From Tel Aviv to Paris, two high-stakes investigations are led by two strong-willed agents. They have 72 hours to unravel this mystery, which is in fact one and the same case. Seventy-two hours of investigation made all the more intense by the bond the duo had forged in the past.

name: The Joy of Painting with Nicholas Hankins: Bob Ross' Unfinished Season
summary: Certified Teacher Trainer Nicholas Hankins brings the never-before-seen paintings that Bob Ross was preparing for the studio before he passed away.

name: Looney Tunes Presents: Sports Made Simple
summary: Bugs Bunny & the rest of the Looney Tunes squad explain sports being played in the Olympics.

name: Idź Przodem, Bracie
summary: After inheriting a hefty debt, an ex-special ops officer — now guarding a shopping mall — spots an opportunity to solve his financial predicament.

name: House of David
summary: Follow the once-mighty King Saul as he falls victim to his own pride. A prophet prepares to overthrow him — anointing the outcast shepherd boy David as a second king. As Saul's fury grows, David navigates love, violence and politics in the court of the very man he's destined to replace. Two kings. One Kingdom. The outcome is war.

name: The Chicken Sisters
summary: The Chicken Sisters is a family drama dipped in southern charm and served up with a saucy side of romance. The setting is the fictional town of Merinac, where a generations-old rift between dueling fried chicken restaurants – Mimi's and Frannie's – has left the founders' families fractured and the locals taking sides. When popular cooking competition show Kitchen Clash comes to town, this could be the recipe for ending this feud once and for all. But things are fixing to heat up both inside and outside of the kitchen as the reality show spotlight causes sparks to fly as secrets are spilled and feathers get ruffled.

name: Supermarket Own-Brands: The Big Taste Test
summary:
In this programme we ask one simple question: can you tell the difference between the brand and the own brands, and which do you prefer?

Own brands used to carry a stigma. They were bland, boring and came in plain packaging. But now they have upped their game and are taking on the brands head on. The packaging often looks similar, and the names can be very cheeky. But when you strip it all back, can the taste match that of the brand? Some people refer to them as knock offs, others call them dupes… they are the supermarket own brands.

name: UFO Encounters UK
summary: Unique access to compelling, never-before-broadcast firsthand accounts of alleged UFO close encounters and alien abductions in the UK.

name: From God to Husband
summary: After rigorous cultivation, humans can ascend to become gods. Above gods are immortals, and above immortals are emperors. Jiang Feng, after a thousand years of hard cultivation, finally ascended to become the Nine Extremes Immortal Emperor. Once mortals broke through the realm of the Immortal Emperor, they could tear through the rift of space and time to defy fate. Determined to rectify all his past regrets, Jiang Feng decided to return to the mortal world. However, upon his return, he discovered that his benefactor, Master Liu, had been poisoned and was in critical condition; his wife, Liu Chenfei, the most beautiful woman in Jiangcheng, was being forced into remarriage; and the entire Jiang family of 138 members had been massacred. At this moment, Jiang Feng unsheathed his Tiangang Sword, which had been sealed for a thousand years.

name: Tang Ren Jie Tan An Zhi Qing Nian Zhen Tan Tuan
Not A Big Deal
summary: In the mid-1980s, childhood sweethearts Wang Xiaoqing and Du Mantang were separated by Wang Xiaoqing's mother's disapproval. Zhang Zezhong seized the opportunity, but later married the vice principal's daughter for his career. When his social climbing failed and his house was nearly ruined from a failed scheme to inflate its price, he ended up disgraced. Thirty years later, both Du Mantang and Zhang Zezhong work as the managers in a neighborhood. Zhang Zezhong tries to profit from the neighborhood decommercialization, but Du Mantang blocks his plans. Zhang Zezhong's scheme to take over a traditional courtyard under false pretenses is thwarted by the community, leading to his arrest. His daughter Zhang Ting pleads for understanding, revealing his actions were driven by a desire to stop his wife from emigrating. Although forgiven by his neighbors, Zhang Zezhong receives a prison sentence with probation. He later sincerely apologizes and is ultimately forgiven by the neighbors.

name: The Truth
summary: The Forensic Unit of the Yunxi City Police Department is where the most major and baffling cases converge. Led by Captain Leng Qiming, a team of young, sharp investigative minds—including Ye Qian, Si Yuanlong, Jiao Lei, and Zhang Ziwu—tackles each puzzle. Among them are profilers who decode the human psyche, tech wizards who master every piece of forensic equipment, seasoned detectives with old-school wisdom, and a slick, quick-witted rookie who provides much-needed levity. United by the principle "To decipher death's code is to guard life's dignity," they each bring a unique skill set to the table. As they peel back the layers of one bewildering crime after another, they expose not just the truth but the raw nature of those involved. Yet just when one mystery seems solved, another emerges from within it. Step by step, as the truth comes to light, so too does the real face of human nature.

name: Summer in Your Name
summary: This is a story about the youth of 17-year-old boys, and how they harvest love, friendship and family affection in their last step towards adulthood. When transfer student Sheng Xia first entered the Affiliated High School of South China University of Technology, she met the school's celebrity Zhang Shu, a legend from a poor student to a god of learning. She misunderstood him as a bad academic bully who "held multiple positions", and he also noticed this soft but slightly temperamental transfer student. Sheng Xia, who had just arrived, faced the higher-intensity learning environment of the Affiliated High School of South China University of Technology, coupled with the opposition between her divorced parents on education issues, she felt very hard, but she still stubbornly held on. Fortunately, in the warm collective of Class 6 of Senior 3, there are good friends who can relieve her inner anxiety like a calf, and there are classmates who can encourage her with fun and decompression. More importantly, like his name, Zhang Shu is like a timely rain that falls on her barren and dry world. The throbbing of youth spreads this summer. They cherish each other. There are figures riding bicycles on Xiangzhang Avenue, there are moments when they look back at each other in the teaching building, there are deeds of young people going against the flow and being brave in Yifang Bookstore, and there are his bold words under the national flag... The teenagers encourage each other and go through the time of senior year together. From teenagers to young adults, they each hold their ideals in their hearts and stride forward, just like this hot summer, shining and dazzling. The story of boys and girls working together to overcome the difficulty of the college entrance examination and rushing from school uniforms to wedding dresses.

name: News and Views
summary: News and Views was an early American evening news program. Broadcast on ABC from 1948 to 1951, it was ABC's first evening news program and one of the first such programs on any television network.

name: After the Deadlines
summary: After the Deadlines was an American evening news program of the early 1950s.

name: ABC World News with Diane Sawyer
summary: With unparalleled resources, World News Tonight with Diane Sawyer provides the latest information and analysis of major events from around the country and the world.

name: World News with Charles Gibson
summary: Get the latest news stories and headlines from around the world.

name: ABC Evening Report
summary: Anchors of the program during the early 1960s, sometimes for short periods, included Alex Dreier, John Secondari, Fendall Winston Yerxa, Al Mann, Bill Shadel, and the three-person team of John Cameron Swayze (formerly of NBC), Bill Lawrence, and Bill Sheehan.

name: World News Tonight with Peter Jennings
World News Tonight with Bob Woodruff and Elizabeth Vargas
Ron Cochran with the News
summary: In 1962, Ron Cochran was appointed as full-time anchor, staying with the program, entitled, "Ron Cochran with the News", until 1965.

name: John Daly and the News
summary: In the fall of 1953, John Daly began anchoring the then-15-minute John Daly and the News. Daly, who served as host of the CBS game show What's My Line? contemporaneously, anchored the newscast until 1960, with multiple hosts and formats succeeding him.

name: City Beats
summary: DJ-producer Carly Foxx is on a musical journey, immersing herself in the life of five iconic European cities to find inspiration.

name: Dracula: Escape the Castle
summary: Welcome to Dracula's castle. Two teams are trapped overnight and must find their way out by locating the key through mental and physical challenges.

name: Against the Current
summary: Shen Jia Lan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jin Qi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jin Qi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

name: Equip & Power with Christine Caine
summary: In this powerful teaching series, Christine Caine will equip and empower you to live out your divine destiny and become all God has created you to be.

name: Mother Angelica Live
summary: Flagship EWTN series hosted by Mother Angelica, mother-superior of a Franciscan cloistered monastery and the founder of EWTN network. Features Bible studies, catechetical homilies, a live studio audience, guests and call-in questions.

name: Nature Is Speaking
summary: In this series of short films, Nature is given a voice to raise awareness that people need nature in order to survive.

name: AM America
summary: AM America was a morning news program produced by ABC

name: Meet You at the Blossom
summary: The charming and wealthy young master of the Jin family, Jin Xiaobao, though a lover of beauty, is also humorous and considerate, always yearning for a good match. On a dark and windy night, his ideal partner suddenly appears before him! The beautiful and cold-hearted Miss Huaien, however, is embroiled in a deadly crisis. How could Xiaobao pass up the chance to play the hero? But instead of winning the beauty as his bride, he ends up compromising himself! This "beauty" not only has a mysterious gender but also an entangled history with the Jin family. When Xiaobao and Huaien finally come to understand each other, will they still have the courage to continue their romance?

name: Watashi no kiraina tantei
summary: Akemi Ninomiya is a hardcore mystery fan. Although she is only a college student, she is wealthy and owns a building. Private Detective Morio Ukai prefers tracking down lost pets for wealthy clients rather than murder cases which brings in little money. The duo join forces to solve various suspicious cases.

name: Night Therapy
summary:
Arab psychologist, Louie Mansur, is left to raise his two children on his own following the crushing suicide of his wife, who long-suffered a battle with depression. Louie's 13-year-old son, Amir, begins to fail his studies and is on the cusp of dropping out, whilst Louie's daughter, Nur, suffers from agonizing abandonment issues and refuses to leave Louie's side. Louie is left with no time to mourn, as his fatherly duties become all consuming.

In an unconventional turn of events, after yet another sleepless night, Louie decides to transfer his clinic hours to the wee hours of the night, accepting patients from dusk till dawn. An eclectic mix of Tel Aviv's nocturnal creatures attends his clinic, along with their compelling stories throughout the series.

name: Всё по-нашему!)
summary: A musical parody show, where the stars of domestic show business joke, sing and amuse the audience exclusively "our way"!

name: The Chairman of Class 9
summary: A delinquent 2nd-year student becomes the chairman of the board of a prestigious high school left behind by his father. Na Yi Soo may have grown up in an environment that others would envy, but he harbors hatred for his father and heads to Balhae High School, which his father cherished, in order to seek revenge. The process of change between Yi Soo, who has lived a rougher life than anyone else, and the nation's most elite students who have lived upright lives, as they get to know each other, and the love that blooms in the process, will be dynamically unfolded.

name: Дневник убийцы
summary: Graduate students in the Historical Museum find a diary dated 1919. In the diary, the author confesses to the murder of five people. The terrible deeds of the past are the key to unraveling a number of crimes committed in our day.

name: Jai Mahendran
summary: Jai Mahendran is an original political drama series.

name: Aapka Apna Zakir
summary: Zakir Khan, along with his four panelists - Shweta Tiwari, Rithvik Dhanjani, Gopal Datt and Paresh Ganatra, host quirky news debates, candid conversations with celebrities and influencers, and special guests who present their unique talents.

name: Pill
summary: Pill unravels the deep-set rot in the Indian pharmaceutical industry. Dr. Prakash along with three whistle-blowers face a powerful pharma giant Forever Cure to expose the corrupt nexus of pharma, middlemen, and doctors through which a pill reaches the common man. Will the good be able to overcome the evil?

name: Minnie's Bow-Toon's: Party Palace Pals
summary: Minnie and her best friend Daisy Duck take on their newest venture: running a party planning business called the Polka Dot Party Palace.

name: Minnie's Bow-Toons: Camp Minnie
summary: Minnie and Daisy have adventures in the great outdoors as they open their latest enterprise, Camp Minnie! They have lots of fun under the sun at this cool new campground in the woods: horseback riding, water sports, sing-alongs, s'mores by the campfire and even a wilderness fashion show. With Clarabelle as Activities Director, Cuckoo-Loca there to lend a wing, and surprise visits from woodland creatures, hijinks abound. Along the way they're joined by old friends and new, because s'more the merrier!

name: Minnie's Bow Toons: Pet Hotel
summary: Minnie and Daisy open a Pet Hotel, where adorable pets come to play, relax, and be pampered. With Clarabelle and Cuckoo-Loca helping out, hijinks abound.

name: Password
summary:
A hilarious word association game hosted by the multi-talented Stephen Mangan. Featuring Alan Carr and Daisy May Cooper as resident Team Captains, each episode sees Alan and Daisy pair up with contestants to give one-word clues that aim to help their teammate guess a mystery ‘password'.

The teams must try to get on each other's wavelengths as they take it in turns to guess the all-important password across multiple rounds - hilarious clues and even funnier guesses are all that stand in the way of lucky contestants being in with a chance to win a big cash prize.

name: M&S: Dress The Nation
summary: Contestants compete to secure an exclusive mentorship with the UK's favourite fashion retailer - M&S, as well as have their winning design sold at M&S.

name: Ермак
summary: The story of Ermak Timofeevich, whose campaign for the Ural mountains served to annex the Siberian lands to the Moscow kingdom, in the second half of the 16th century.

name: Нежный барс
summary:
A young woman named Lyudmila works in a remote taiga reserve. She carries out a difficult man's task alone, holding the post of Deputy Director for Science. Her father once held this position, but he died... Now Lyuda has to fight poachers and save the taiga deer population.
But what to do if bandits are increasingly shooting animals, threatening the management of the reserve, and cowardly management is in no hurry to come to the aid of employees? There is taiga for 500 kilometers around. There is nowhere to wait for salvation... Luda decides to figure everything out herself. A brave woman must single-handedly confront an entire gang of poachers...

name: Dragonights
summary: In 2007, the Ice Goblins, led by Danacus, invaded Earth. Despite facing unexpected human resistance, the war lasted for years. However, everything changed when an unforeseen meteor crashed into a city twelve years later. From the supernatural ashes of the rubble, a group of teens rose to power and defeated Danacus. Yet, the retreat of the alien invader signals a looming return. In 2024, rising crime and Skorpion activity hint at his comeback. The "Dragonights" series follows their struggle, a tale of intergalactic conflict, human resilience, and globally recognized heroes.

name: Last Seen
summary: Police detective Ian Ridley's life fell apart 11 years ago when his young daughter, Maggie, disappeared without a trace. Now working as a police dispatcher, the only thing that has kept him going is his implacable refusal to accept that she might be gone forever. When he receives a distress call from a teenage girl he is certain is Maggie, he will stop at nothing to find her and reunite his broken family, whatever the cost.

name: Sirens
summary: Devon thinks her sister Simone has a really creepy relationship with her new boss, the enigmatic socialite Michaela Kell. Michaela's cult-ish life of luxury is like a drug to Simone, and Devon has decided it's time for an intervention, but she has no idea what a formidable opponent Michaela will be. Told over the course of one explosive weekend at The Kells' lavish beach estate, Sirens is an incisive, sexy, and darkly funny exploration of women, power, and class.

name: Król Zanzibaru
summary: Hailed the "King of Zanzibar" for his luxury travel destination, Wojtek Żabiński's high society life crashes to a halt when he's accused of fraud.

name: Клубничка
summary: The friendly Koshkin family starts their own business and opens a private family cafe called "Strawberry". The heroes of the series manage to get into different comical situations, and very diverse cafe visitors help them in this.

name: Звёздный дурак
summary: Igor Dzhabrailov and Dmitry Zhuravlev invite guests to play an improv card game

name: Me Too!
summary: Preschool drama about the parallel lives of parents at work and their children who stay with warm-hearted minder Granny Murray.

name: Teen Torture, Inc.
summary: Teen Torture Inc. follows on-going efforts to expose America's "troubled teen" industry (TTI).  For six decades and counting, this billion-dollar business has used what it calls "tough love" as a form of treatment despite numerous deaths, countless suicides, life-altering injuries, and instances of child sexual abuse. Until recently, nobody has been able to stop it. The series follows a recurring band of young survivors and whistleblowers and their harrowing first-hand accounts of extreme abuse and cult-like brainwashing at the hands of these programs, starting a social media firestorm in 2021. Survivors, including rap star Bhad Bhabie, are determined to take down this business once and for all. While they have seen impressive victories, the "troubled teen" industry has long been protected by power and is not going down without a fight.

name: Wiggin' Out with Tokyo Stylez
summary: Wiggin' Out with Tokyo Stylez follows Tokyo as she takes center stage, shaping hair dreams into reality one strand at a time. This series gives viewers an inside look as Tokyo meets with, curates and installs wigs for high-profile clientele such as Cardi B, Trina Braxton, Reginae Carter, TS Madison, Tiffany "New York" Pollard, AriFletcher, FloMilliand more. Each episode showcases Tokyo's unique creative process, from the first stitch to the final transformative installation. Each wig comes with its own set of challenges, and Tokyo must balance deadlines, client demands and finding time for life outside of the salon.

name: You Are Ms. Servant
summary: This is the story of a maid who is all alone in the world, but who finally finds a family. Told from young that her only worth is as a killer, Yuki had known nothing else except cold efficiency and following orders. Now that she has a chance to leave her past behind, she arrives at the doorstep of Hitoyoshi Yokoya, asking to be employed… as a maid?! Thus begins the journey of a former assassin learning what it means to be ‘normal'!

previousepisode.name: The Joyous Tidings You All Bring.

name: Strange & Suspicious
summary: Strange & Suspicious digs deep into the world of unexplained, unsolved, downright weird stories from across the globe with the help of a retired cop, a private investigator, an archaeologist, a UFO investigator, a mathematician, and others.

name: Spiked
summary:
EastEnders is working on a new storyline that will see Anna Knight (Molly Rainford) get her drink spiked. 

Anna is set to find herself in danger later this summer when she gets spiked whilst on a night out at Peggy's. With her friends believing that Anna's behaviour is down to alcohol, the incident initially goes unnoticed, but Anna's friends soon become concerned for her welfare when they realise that her behaviour does not equate to the little amount of alcohol she has actually consumed…

In a digital first for EastEnders, an exclusive five part mini-series will be made accessible to viewers via a QR code that will feature within the main episode which will take the audience to a link giving them the option of which platform to watch through. The digital series will offer a unique insight as viewers see the incident from Anna's own perspective, and from the perspective of her friends.

As Anna grapples with her detachment from reality, viewers of the mini-series will experience the internal warning signs to look out for when spiked, whereas additional footage captured by Anna's friends will showcase the outward effects the drugs have on her behaviour and mobility.

name: All-Star News
summary: All Star News in 1952

name: Megha Barsenge
summary: A simple newly wed bride gets deceived and abandoned by her NRI groom, takes charge of herself overcomes deceit and restores her and her family's respect and charts for herself a 'New Life'.

name: Are You Sure?
summary: Follow the unpredictable and exciting journey of BTS's Jimin and Jung Kook!

previousepisode.name: The Final Adventure in Da Nang

name: Primetime with the Murthys
summary: The breaking news of a big Bollywood actor committing suicide sparks controversial conversations in living rooms across the country including the Murthys living a quiet life in Bengaluru. Nisha and Shiv Murthy, a pair of siblings, embark on a complex self-discovery journey trying to navigate their way through the beast of social media and the race to stay relevant. Through humor and relatable situations, Murthys explores the complexities of family dynamics in today's digital age. This coming-of-age series is about the impact of the toxic news cycle on young adults.

name: Lee Anderson's Real World
summary: Lee Anderson brings the Real World to the Great British public, as the silent majority finally have their voices heard in the Conservative deputy chairman's brand-new current affairs show.

name: Oh Baby!
summary: How animal parents teach their babies survival skills that help them thrive in the changing seasons.

name: Een moord kost meer levens
summary: When his father is arrested for murdering two children, Paul Spruit is still an adolescent. From that moment on, normal life is no longer possible for the Spruit family. Then they have to deal with the violent ex-husband of Paul's mother. Because reports do nothing, Paul takes the law into his own hands: in a blind rage he stabs his stepfather to death.

name: Jin Wu Wei Zhi Feng Qi Jin Ling
Gawdar
summary: A merchant has three children; Salem, Salim, and Gawdar. However, the life of the last son, Gawdar, becomes complicated, and he comes into conflict with the enemy Shimoun to reach the four treasures of the wiseman Shamardal.

name: He is from The Cheng Group
summary: Cheng Tang, once the promising eldest grandson of the Cheng family, was driven out and nearly killed by scheming enemies. But instead of giving up, he was taken in by Mr. Lin as his live-in son-in-law. Coincidentally, Lin Chuxue, the heroine, was his childhood savior. Though she sees him as only a nominal husband, Cheng Tang hides his true identity, growing stronger and plotting his return to the Cheng family while protecting Lin Chuxue. In the end, he achieves a fulfilling love.

name: Path to Paris
summary: Filmed over three years, this raw and honest documentary series follows Ireland's top medal prospects as they strive to qualify for the Olympic and Paralympic Games.

name: The Secret of Us
summary: Doctor Lada, whose alias is angel doctor, was left with a scar on her heart by old love, causing her to be unable to open up for someone anymore. She must reunite with Earn, that ex-girlfrend who hurt her heart the worst, when she becomes a new presenter for the hospital where she works.

name: Lost You, Found You
summary: Yun Feifei, a detective from Liushanmen, and Gu Linyuan, a high-ranking member of the Qiankun Gang, are sworn enemies. However, after uncovering each other's true identities, they realize they are long-lost lovers with deep emotional ties. As they rekindle their romance, the mysteries of the past gradually unravel.

name: Raising Fame
summary: Raising Fame delves beyond the glitz and glamour to provide a unique perspective in the words of both the parents and celebrated children themselves.

name: Family Practice Mysteries
summary: A former Army surgeon moves back to her hometown and joins a practice of family doctors, but when she's drawn into solving the mysterious death of a patient, her quiet life becomes upended.

name: Sky News at 7pm
summary: A summary of the latest news headlines.

name: Tipline Mysteries
summary: A cryptic call about a planned jewelry heist draws a Detroit Free Press tipline operator, Maddie Moore, into a dangerous homicide case alongside a newly promoted detective.

name: Ibiza Narcos
summary: Ibiza Narcos is the story of how a tiny, sleepy Mediterranean Island was transformed into one the world's most vibrant party capitals, fuelled by a dangerous and lucrative drugs trade which drew as many criminals to its shores as it did party animals.

name: Ненормальная
summary: Because of her bandaged face, she is called Mummy in the children's ward. In two months, disfigured Anya had to seriously grow up. Before the accident, she was a beautiful, confident schoolgirl. Afterwards - a closed, cynical creature, ready to attack even those who are trying to help her. Every day Anya looks for new reasons to live on and new tricks to stay in the hospital. After all, she recently had a goal - to kill the culprit who was lying in a coma in the very accident in which her parents died. To carry out her plan, Anya gathers a team of loser patients, but in the process of preparation she realizes that revenge is not a cure.

name: The Beginning of the Sea
summary: Tsukioka Natsu is 28 years old. He works for a printing company in Tokyo. One day, Tsukioka Natsu hears that Nagumo Mizuki died. They were in a romantic relationship when they attended the same university. They broke up after Nagumo Mizuki suddenly told him that she wanted to end their relationship, and she disappeared afterwards. He didn't hear anything about her for the past 7 years after their breakup. Tsukioka Natsu attends Nagumo Mizuki's funeral, where he meets a young child named Umi. He is surprised to learn that Umi is Mizuki Nagumo's daughter. Nagumo Mizuki's mother talks to him and tells him that Umi is his daughter.

name: Born To
summary: Born To is a series of life-affirming short films, which tell emotionally-charged stories of talented and successful athletes at the top of their game.

previousepisode.name: Born To Be The Best On Wheels

name: True Beauty
summary:
Tired of being looked down upon for her unattractive appearance, middle schooler Lim Jugyeong turns to the transformative powers of makeup. First, she experiments with BB cream, lip tint, and eyeliner; then she begins using mascara, double eyelid glue, and colored contacts. Before she knows it, Jugyeong goes from being a girl who is bullied for her ugliness to being praised as a high-class beauty. Constantly surrounded by those who adore her goddess-like appearance, Jugyeong can now live a more than comfortable life at school—she simply has to keep her bare face a secret.

However, everything changes when the new transfer student, Lee Suho, enters her life. Not only does the handsome Suho become immediately popular among their peers, but in a chance encounter, he also becomes the only classmate of Jugyeong's to see her face beneath the makeup. With her reputation on the line, Jugyeong must do whatever it takes to hide the truth about her appearance from the rest of her classmates. But the more time she spends with Suho, the more Jugyeong finds herself questioning whether one's true beauty lies solely in their looks.

name: Soul Mate
summary: Haunted by guilt and doubt, Ryu flees Japan for Berlin and is saved by Korean boxer Johan. Their chance encounter binds their destiny for years to come.

name: Bodies in the Water
summary: When a missing high school student is found shackled in chains off the shore of Cape May, investigators are baffled by what kind of monster could commit such a heinous murder. Their investigation leads them to uncover jealous boyfriends and turmoil within the victim's foster family that sends shockwaves throughout the tightknit community.

name: Sasha Reid and the Midnight Order
summary: Sasha Reid and the Midnight Order follows Reid and her secret society who share a common obsession - the dark psychology of those who commit harm and the desire to protect those that law enforcement has ignored. They band together to work outside the system to protect the vulnerable, solve cold cases, and dive into the dark minds of killers using forensic expertise and world-class data skills. Their motto is to have compassion first, but let the evidence lead.

name: ХОУМИС
summary: HOMIES is an entertaining quiz in which two pairs of friends compete in the ability to understand each other. The show consists of several rounds, which are united by one goal – to understand how well each participant knows the way his friend thinks.

name: One Step Forward
summary: The story takes place in a typical Beijing community: ancient buildings and new functions are integrated and overlapped, new and old residents live next to each other, and community work is complicated.

name: The Rise of Wanshan
summary: At the end of the last century, Wanshan Special Zone in Guizhou was facing a desperate situation due to the depletion of mercury resources. Feng Baiyang, a third-generation mercury miner, held a strong sense of responsibility and mission, and achieved transformation and development based on technological innovation and green development, making a resource-depleted city reborn from the ashes and making the dream of innovative development come true.

name: Il caso Yara: oltre ogni ragionevole dubbio
summary: This docuseries digs into the disappearance of 13-year-old Yara and the disconcerting investigation that shattered the peace of a small Italian town.

name: How to Die Alone
summary: How to Die Alone follows Melissa, a fat, Black neurotic who's never been in love. After a comical brush with death, she refuses to settle for anything less than the life she wants, catapulting her on a journey to becoming "100% that bitch" in real life by any means necessary.

name: Riding Phat
summary: Riding Phat follows the Phat Scooters team as they design, build, and deliver awesome electric scooters to celebrity clients and people who love to Ride Phat!

name: Mina, Lilje og meg
summary: We are joining Alexander and Mina (6) on another long trip. This time, little sister Lilje (3) also gets to join her very first winter expedition.

name: Shang suo de fang jian
summary: Mu Xia is a talented locksmith. While dealing with a strange murder case within a locked room, Qin Zuo Man inadvertently discovers that Mu Xia is the new security consultant hired by the police academy. As more locked room cases arise, the simple-minded Qin Zuo Man, the monotonous Mu Xia and celebrity cop Tan You join hands to form an investigative team that seeks to uncover the truth through every door.

name: Toda Família Tem
summary: Pê was living his best years but gets frustrated when his family decides to move to his grandmother's house in Rio de Janeiro, his hometown. He's forced to give up his comfort to live in a house full of relatives while trying to find his place in the world. Let's follow Pê's journey to find out that it's impossible to escape the comical demands of the family.

name: Better Together
summary: Better Together is an daily original program made by women for women! We discuss faith, family, friends and much more-no topic is off limits. We are building a community of women committed to doing life together and making our world a better place.

name: Takeaways with Kirk Cameron
summary: Joining Kirk Cameron to discuss pressing issues Christians are facing with compassionate, well-informed guests, in order to find actionable takeaways that everyone can use throughout life to bring more of Heaven to Earth.

name: The Story Behind the Story with Mike Rowe
summary: Based on the stories Mike Rowe wrote for his podcast, "The Way I Heard It".

name: Pastor Robert Morris Ministries
summary: Pastor Robert Morris offers religious guidance by sharing God's views and teachings to help devotees find meaning in their everyday lives.

name: The Winning Walk with Dr. Ed Young
summary: A broadcast from Dr. Ed Young that takes its title from his first book, "The Winning Walk, Outfitting For The Christian Adventure."

name: Kingdom Connection with Jentezen Franklin
summary: Pastor Jentezen Franklin brings practical meaning to spiritual truths found in the Word of God.

name: Norges dummeste
summary: Twelve celebrities fight to avoid the title "Norges dummeste". The participants are tested on knowledge that everyone should have, and in each episode the smartest gets to go home. This is the competition no one wants to win!

previousepisode.name: Dette kan bare gå til helvete

nextepisode.name: Den Beste Taktikken I Norges Dummestes Historie

name: How to be a Gardener
summary: In How to be a Gardener, Alan Titchmarsh draws on his extensive knowledge and experience to give you a comprehensive guide to becoming a successful gardener.

name: Silence
summary: Silence follows ACP Avinash Verma as he investigates mysterious murders. As his team delves deeper into the case, a darker conspiracy is revealed.

previousepisode.name: Silence 2: The Night Owl Bar Shootout

name: Dr. Phil True Crime
summary: From murders to missing persons, Dr. Phil examines crimes from clinical, forensic, and social-psychological standpoints. With his classic no-nonsense approach, viewers gain expert insight into the minds of criminals, victims, and the impact of these events on our society at-large.

name: Faites entrer l'accusé : Crimes flagrants
summary: A new variation of the flagship program which evokes cases in which the identity of the culprit is quickly known but the investigation gets bogged down on the motivations of the perpetrator.

previousepisode.name: Sur la route des tueurs de masse
